g.text: Six synchronous calls, and the customer waits for all of them
p50 ≈ 5 seconds — and any one failure fails the whole order.
After — only what the customer needs is inline
p50 ≈ 1.3 seconds. The rest happens after the customer has gone.
A background thread would also be fast — and would lose
every in-flight job the next time you deploy.
The queue is there for DURABILITY, not just for speed.
